description: Find ready-made business contact lists for sale by industry and location. Returns up to 10 lists, best match first (the exact city, then its state/province, then the country): name, scope, number of businesses, how many have an email, price, and preview and buy links. Location can be a city ("Austin", "Austin, TX"), a state or province ("Ontario"), or a country ("USA", "Canada", "Australia"); spelling is matched loosely. Use when someone needs leads or prospects of a type of local business.

location.description: City, state/province or country in the US, Canada or Australia, e.g. "Austin, TX", "Ontario", "USA".

trade.description: Industry, as a slug from list_trades or in plain words, e.g. "dentists", "hvac", "real estate agents", "businesses without a website".

name: search_lists
title: Search business lists
